name: education-harness
description: A visible, adaptive learning companion that remembers the learner's place, words, goals and chosen way of learning.

interface.longDescription: An adaptive learning companion that helps you start, continue and understand a learning path. It remembers your place and your own words, supports civic overview through advanced depth, and offers a project-led data-science path when you do not yet know where to begin.
defaultPrompt: Let's learn. Show me what Education Harness can do, then ask the first setup question.
Let's go—continue from where I left off.
Show me the default data-science learning path and help me choose a depth.
